summary.en:
Ran, Sonoko, and Conan are at a yoga resort, when one of its customers, Atsuko Degawa, dies from poison found in her food. It's deduced to be a suicide.

Location: Yoga diet training studio (Chandni)

Victim: Atsuko Degawa

suspects: Tsukiko Satoyama, Kaoru Iimori, and Yasuko Inomata
suspectsZh: 里山月子、饭森薰与猪俣康子
